metadata.description: Guardrails and audits for the mistakes that pass every check — config drift, shell portability, lost context, accidental releases, leaked secrets

plugins.name: census
plugins.description: Read-only audit of scattered .claude/ configs — catalog what you have, detect drift, and triage which items are portable enough to share with a team.

plugins.name: atlas
plugins.description: A browsable HTML map of every Claude Code resource a project can reach — commands, agents, skills, hooks, MCP servers and memory across your user config, this repo, and every installed plugin, plus a ranked report of what it all costs in always-on context.

plugins.name: shell-portability
plugins.description: Reviews shell scripts for bash/zsh portability — catches BASH_SOURCE, array indexing, glob nomatch and word-splitting differences before the other shell hits them.

plugins.name: session-continuity
plugins.description: Carries long-running work across context resets — keeps a plan file current as you go, and generates the handoff prompt that lets a fresh session pick up exactly where this one stopped.

plugins.name: release-guards
plugins.description: Puts a confirmation in front of the release actions you cannot take back — creating or deleting a tag, publishing a release, and editing the automation that generates them.

plugins.name: sensitive-guard
plugins.description: Stops a secret at the moment of commit — a last-mile gate that scans the lines a commit adds and blocks it, plus an on-demand scan of a whole repository before you publish.
